v_bias.source: mid-scale of the ADC's 0 to 3.1 V range at 12 dB (ESP32-S3 datasheet), within 100 mV

g_low.source: a 0 dBm pair (2.2 V peak) must stay inside 0 to 3.1 V around the bias: gain at most 0.8; at least 0.6 keeps a -20 dBm digit 30 dB over the ADC's noise

g_high.source: as g_low, at the top DTMF column, 1633 Hz

twist.source: the path adds under 0.2 dB of twist; the decoder takes the high tone 4 dB over to 8 dB under the low (firmware/src/dtmf.h DTMF_TWIST_FWD_DB, DTMF_TWIST_REV_DB; ITU-T Q.24 Table A-1)
